context: REVERSE of ss.client_add -- DELETE /clients/{id} on the HOSTING Security Server for a hosted joined member (PTSB:SCHOLARSHIP on ss-plr), issued while GET /clients/{id} still reports DELETION_IN_PROGRESS (see unjoin.client_unregister.probe.json). Accepted 204 with no intervening 409: this capture is 62s after unjoin.client_unregister.json, which is the whole elapsed time between the two calls, not a measured wait -- nothing was retried and no 409 was ever seen, so how much sooner it would have been accepted is NOT established by this fixture. What it does establish is that DELETION_IN_PROGRESS does not block the delete, and that the multi-minute '409 action_not_possible then wait' docs/decisions/xroad-770-notes.md 7 recorded for an OWN-SERVER member does not reproduce here. X-Road 7.7.0, live.
